result.Method of Attack: Injected obfuscated wallet-drainer malware that hooks into fetch, XMLHttpRequest, and wallet provider APIs to rewrite crypto transaction addresses on the fly, replacing them with attacker-controlled addresses across multiple chains (Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana, Tron, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash).
result.Impacted Systems: npm ecosystem, Developers and users of DuckDB-related packages and other affected npm packages
result.Attack Vector: Phishing email targeting maintainers (duckdb_admin account) leading to compromised npm account and publishing of malicious package versions
result.Indicators of Compromise: Compromised package versions: duckdb@1.3.3, @duckdb/duckdb-wasm@1.29.2, @duckdb/node-api@1.3.3, @duckdb/node-bindings@1.3.3, prebid@10.9.1, prebid@10.9.2, @coveops/abi@2.0.1; Obfuscated code pattern matching wallet address regexes for Ethereum, Bitcoin (Legacy and Segwit), Tron, Bitcoin Cash, Litecoin, Solana; Phishing email and fake npm site (npmjs.help) used to compromise maintainers; On-chain flagged Ethereum address linked to the exploit; Malicious releases published on 2025-09-09 UTC early morning hours
